lokasi: The front terrace of a simple, tidy Indonesian family house in the late afternoon: a closed brown wooden front door in the center, a small window to the right of the door, a low wooden shoe rack to the left of the door, a green potted plant at the right edge, light grey tiled floor, warm sunlight coming from the left
